curvature.note: the registration states about 0.06 pp, a fitted estimate with partial cancellation between arms
curvature.source: study 1's fitted curves (study2_short_sim.STUDY1) at K*, baseline 0.15; M4, decided

coverage.scenarios: every coverage scenario but C14, whose 5 % are MNAR among harmful responses
coverage.source: no record holds study 3's rate (study 2's labels were never made); M6b, decided
coverage.use: stress values: the coverage test reads the primary interval alone (M24)

power.decision: the researcher's, after preliminary calculations showed the power gate failing at 1 % MCAR; it changes the planning alternative of the power requirement (docs/study3-preregistration.md, 'Simulation before validation'); the registration sets no rate, and the required simulation itself stays prospective
power.definition: the share of labels still unresolved after the labeling rounds the registration allows (docs/study3-preregistration.md, 'Judge and audit': up to three rounds per run)
power.limitation: missing completely at random. Run- or arm-level clustered label failures are not explicitly modeled. The stress scenarios cover higher MCAR missingness and harmful-response-dependent MNAR. They are 1 % MCAR in the coverage scenarios and 5 % MNAR among harmful responses in C14
power.scenarios: every power scenario: the power gate reads them (M20)
power.source: study 1 with the same judge, WildGuard: 0 unparseable outputs in 39 900 labels of its non-collapsed runs (docs/reports/stage-1.md, 'Judge labeling'); study 1's rate over all its runs includes its collapsed runs, which are not representative, and is not used; M6b, decided
power.status: a conservative planning assumption for supported runs, not a proven upper bound: the bound from 0 in 39 900 assumes independent labels and is computed on a selected subset, the non-collapsed runs

report.coupling: one uniform per label on the study's label stream, the label missing when its uniform is below the rate: the 1 % mask contains the 0.1 % mask
report.draws: each study's own streams (the screen's calibration base, the scenario's name and the study's index) and its power scenario's frozen calibration: the same search, validation, confirmation, label and bootstrap draws; under MCAR, delta scales by 0.99 / 0.999 (+2 or -2 pp becomes about +1.982 or -1.982 pp), and the SD need not shrink by exactly 1 %
report.reading: the registered procedure at the denser mask: its own validation spread, N, cap and confirmation, and the cap's final direction common to the three computations of 'Judge and audit' (study3_estimates.three_way_reading); a study detects when that reading is confirmatory in the direction of delta, and one the denser mask leaves unconfirmed does not
report.role: reported beside power_af, not a gate: it has no requirement, and the n_min scan does not read it; it uses the N the rule chose, before any n_min increase, and is not the power of the final increased design
report.source: how the power falls if labels go missing ten times as often as planned; M6b, decided
report.studies: each power study of the screen, at every level; at a level, the studies power_af counts there (the first M confirmed by index), paired; the results give it at power_af's level

draw_bound.rule: each test draws at most max_draws_factor times M studies; an A-F test short of M eligible studies at the bound is incomplete, not failed: the run stops, naming it, and the same indexed stream is to be extended under a recorded computational limit; a P-F or joint test short at the bound is not attainable, which withholds P-F; a power rate counts the missing studies as not detecting

joint_verification.rule: the joint test of the verification
joint_verification.source: counted over the studies confirmed for A-F; a study misses jointly if A-F misses, or if P-F is active in it and misses; M27, decided

level_and_floor.rule: L is the first level whose A-F tests at N >= 60 and at the cap all pass; each comparison's floor is the smallest of 36, 45, 60 such that its tests at and above that size, the cap counted at that floor, pass at L; P-F's tests are its own and the joint ones, and it is read at L or withheld, never at another level; a cap test at a floor counts only the studies whose reading is confirmatory there
level_and_floor.source: docs/study3-preregistration.md, amendment 7, 'The simulation's stops'; M18 and M29, decided

pf_verification.rule: in the verification a P-F test counts only the studies in which P-F is active (the validation gate of the study's final candidate passed: a P-F closed at candidate 1 reopens at candidate 2, amendment 7)
pf_verification.source: P's actual activity in the realized procedure; M16, decided

screen_simplifications.rule: the screen runs the scenario's candidate with no fallback (a failed A-F gate ends the study, counted), takes N from the rule alone and computes P-F in every confirmed study as if active
screen_simplifications.source: the coverage and power tests are per candidate; A-F's analysis set does not depend on P's activity; M14 and M16, decided

verification_streams.rule: each level's verification has its preassigned stream, derived from the verification stream and the level alone
verification_streams.source: every possible verification test is in J before any draw, and no level's draws depend on whether another's ran (amendment 7); M28, decided
